highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, and new Linux and Tizen assets. The engine upgrade also changes font defaults, Vulkan requirements, platform support, and long-obsolete APIs, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy drawing, text, and sampling APIs are compile errors
breaking.body: Pre-v4 obsoletes including SKPaint text and font state, paint-only text overloads, legacy glyph buffers, sample-count GPU constructors, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality are removed from the reference surface. Move text state to SKFont, use explicit SKSamplingOptions and SKTextAlign values, and adopt the replacement constructors and span properties.

breaking.title: Default font and typeface semantics change
breaking.body: A parameterless SKFont now uses SKTypeface.Empty and draws no text until given a typeface; SKPaint.Typeface and missing SKTypeface.FromFamilyName results now fall back to SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, use SKTypeface.IsEmpty to detect an empty face, and use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when a strict missing-font null result is required.

breaking.title: Vulkan now requires version 1.1
breaking.body: Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context for a Vulkan 1.0 instance now terminates the process instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same supported version; Vulkan 1.0-only devices must use another backend.

breaking.title: Vulkan interop structures change
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 where applicable. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo becomes GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo with a new Components field and no legacy value-equality operators, so update names, initializers, and any layout-dependent interop.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those target frameworks now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Tizen arm and x86 native packages are no longer produced after upstream toolchain requirements made those EOL targets unusable. Move Tizen deployments to the tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 assets.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException when the offset does not fit in the native 32-bit value instead of truncating it. Use the int overload with a validated in-range offset.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only
breaking.body: Custom SKNativeObject subclasses can no longer change IgnorePublicDispose through its protected setter. Pass the intended disposal behavior through the constructor path instead.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that require the previous assembly version.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine gains newer image orientation, HDR, wide-gamut, color filter, drop-shadow, raster, codec, runtime-effect, and malformed-region behavior across the milestone updates and targeted bug-fix syncs.

bullets.lead: Bundled codecs and font engines refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to newer upstream releases.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design positions, named instances, palette selection, and per-color overrides for variable and color fonts.
SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output using span-based overloads.

bullets.lead: Explicit sampling for surface and bitmap draws
bullets.detail: New SKSurface, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for explicit mipmap and filter selection.
SKStream.GetData() returns ref-counted SKData when the native stream can expose its backing data directly.

bullets.lead: New path, color, document, GPU, and filter APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKPathBuilder, CICP color spaces, HDR and RF16 color types, SKDocumentXpsOptions, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and the HBColor value type.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates
bullets.detail: SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes and the correct axis, returning the right pixels for subsets and non-square images.

bullets.lead: Font initialization is safer across Android and NanoServer
bullets.detail: Default typeface resolution no longer crashes during Android startup, and Windows NanoServer uses an empty font manager when no font subsystem exists.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Disposal avoids flushing a finalized SKPathBuilder, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives MAUI tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface and rendering blank.
The projection assembly is packaged under compatible target frameworks so .NET 9 applications can load it at startup.
Lazy, per-type initialization removes the startup cycle, shared native singletons are no longer freed by wrapper teardown, and wrappers remain alive across in-flight native calls.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility checks run on first interop use
bullets.detail: The version gate moves from module initialization to SkiaApi initialization, allowing applications to configure custom native-library resolution before the first P/Invoke.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets
bullets.detail: Adds linux-bionic assets for x64 and arm64 plus native packages for the official tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime identifiers.

bullets.lead: Apple libraries use the base 26.0 workload
bullets.detail: Apple NuGet libraries target version 26.0 instead of 26.2, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for the newest point-version workload.
Updates the bundled XML parser to libexpat 2.8.1 with the upstream release's security hardening.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and compatibility support for modern C# on legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable fonts, default typeface resolution, the SKPath finalizer fix, singleton lifecycle hardening, and Uno sample improvements
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: The Android SKGLView reattachment fix for MAUI TabBar navigation

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Begins the v4 preview line with Skia m147, variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It removes 32-bit Tizen assets, advances the assembly version to 4.x, changes default font semantics, makes out-of-range SKStream.Move(long) calls throw, refreshes libexpat and libpng, and fixes Android typeface startup and SKGLView tab reattachment.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData(), fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple workload compatibility by targeting the base 26.0 platform version.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8 and adopts GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, while adding HBColor, XPS document creation, resource-specific GPU flushes, and shader mask filters. It also fixes NanoServer font initialization and refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, and zlib.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.summary: Updates to Skia m148 and HarfBuzz 14.2.0, adds RF16 and explicit bitmap sampling, promotes legacy text APIs to errors, and applies libexpat security hardening. It also hardens singleton and native-library initialization, corrects pixel spans, and fixes WinUI projection loading.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled shaping engine from 8.3.1.6, adds variable-font and color font palette APIs with the HBColor value type, and includes Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
